heading: Fall Events & Festivals in the Okanagan, October–November 2026
title: Okanagan Fall Events & Festivals 2026 | Okanagan Roam
description: Cider fest, Oktoberfest, film festivals, Skate Canada, harvest dinners, farmers' markets and a big book sale across the Okanagan, Oct–Nov 2026.
intro: This guide covers the fall 2026 season, from mid-October into November. It's a short list of the events that stand out: a cider fest on the Lake Country Cider Trail, two Oktoberfests, film festivals, world-class figure skating in Kelowna, harvest dinners and the markets that keep going into the cooler months. Dates and details can change, so check each event page before you go.
Events are grouped by type. Each one shows its town and date.

items.name: Field of Screams XIII: The Unlucky
